title: Statin Addition to Chemotherapy for Advanced Pancreatic Cancer

sections.abstract: The results of previous studies conducted by our team have revealed that the use of statins can more effectively hinder the growth of drug-resistant pancreatic cancer cells. The primary objective of this study was to investigate the role of statins in treating pancreatic cancer by assessing the safety and therapeutic impact of combining chemotherapy with statins in patients with advanced pancreatic cancer.
